answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the willow log shows the live set and the plume audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 687 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 286 aliases alive hence means 286 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the wharf quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
